title: Warba Bank - Waves Wednesday Campaign
description: Astroshot produced a 3D motion graphics explainer video for Warba Bank’s Waves Wednesday campaign, created to clearly present the Wednesday offers tied to their new bank cards. The project covered the full creative process, including scriptwriting, storyboard development, voice-over, and animation, to turn the offer details into a smooth and engaging visual story. The result was a polished banking campaign video designed to make the promotion easier to understand and more appealing to customers.
